items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 6 at 2:29AM EDT until October 8 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 25 knots with gusts up to 30 knots
and seas 6 to 8 feet expected.

* WHERE...Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 0-20 nm.

* WHEN...From 8 AM Wednesday to 2 AM EDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
